name: Starter: Armenian
about: Armenian in real, everyday sentences, with each one's words in Armenian order.

words.լինել: be (եմ am, ես are, է is, ենք, եք, են are; էի, էինք was, were; չեմ, չի not)
words.դու: you (to a friend; քեզ: you, to you)
words.ունենալ: have (ունեմ: I have, ունե՞ք: do you have?, չունեմ: I don't have)
words.տուն: house, home (տանը: at home, տնից: from home)
words.դուր գալ: please (ինձ դուր է գալիս: it pleases me, I like it)
words.կա: there is (կա՞: is there?, չկա: there isn't, չկար: there wasn't)
words.տալ: give (տվեք: give, to a stranger or more than one)
words.գիտենալ: know (գիտեմ: I know, չգիտեմ: I don't know)

words.means: խմե՞մ = shall I drink?; խմում = drinking

concept.line: Be is a short word that changes with who: եմ (am), ես (are, to a friend), է (is), ենք (we are), եք (you are), են (they are): Ես բժիշկ եմ (I doctor am), Տունը մեծ է (house-the big is).
A question keeps its order and puts ՞ on the word it asks about, over its last vowel: Ինչպե՞ս ես։ (how are-you?), Դուք անգլերեն խոսո՞ւմ եք։ (you English speaking are?).
My and your can be an ending (մայրս: my mom, եղբայրդ: your brother) or a word before the noun, which then takes the: իմ քույրը (my sister-the).

words.means: ունեմ = I have; ունե՞ս = do you have?; չունեմ = I don't have

concept.line: The joins the end of the noun: -ը after a consonant, -ն after a vowel or before a word that starts with one: տունը (the house), կայարանը (the station), Սա իմ տունն է (this my house-the is).
The present pairs the verb's -ում form with a form of be, which goes after the verb or before it, after the word in focus: գրում եմ (writing am-I), Ես սուրճ եմ խմում (I coffee am drinking).

words.means: տունն = house; տանը = in a house; տունը = house

concept.line: ունեմ is I have, ունես you have, ունի has, and չունեմ I don't have: Ես մի եղբայր ունեմ (I a brother have).

words.means: գնամ = I go; գնալ = to go
